user.title: EcoFlow Smart Charge
user.description: Select existing entities. No cloud credentials. Use identical slot order in all battery lists. Starts in shadow only.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure sources
reconfigure.description: Only without a pending session. Preserve slot order and repeat shadow comparison afterwards.

error.three_batteries_required: Select exactly three entities in each battery list.
error.duplicate_reserves: Each entity in a battery list must be distinct.
error.source_invalid: Missing, unavailable, wrong or duplicate source, or invalid tariff/writer selection.
error.unit_invalid: Source unit or value is invalid.

abort.already_configured: At least one reserve target is already owned by another entry.
abort.recovery_pending: Pending recovery: source mappings cannot be changed.

init.title: Controller options
init.description: Active control requires explicitly confirmed safe cutover. Migration must preserve existing values instead of replacing them with defaults.

error.invalid_setting: Invalid or non-finite setting outside supported bounds.
error.unsafe_mode: Activation requires explicitly confirmed safe cutover.

recalculate.name: Recalculate plan
recalculate.description: Refresh and evaluate the configured sources through the runtime. Shadow never sends hardware commands; in active mode normal safety and recovery gates still apply.

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry
config_entry_id.description: Select exactly one loaded EcoFlow Smart Charge entry.

request_cutover.name: Request supervised cutover
request_cutover.description: Explicitly request active control. Requires recorded shadow comparison, fresh valid sources, no pending recovery, confirmed reserves and all configured legacy writers off. Does not disable legacy automations.

confirmed.name: Explicit confirmation
confirmed.description: Intentionally set true only after all safety checks; never default opt-in.

confirm_recovery.name: Authorize exclusive recovery
confirm_recovery.description: Explicitly authorize restoration of saved individual reserves outside shadow, only with exclusive writer ownership. Acknowledgement is not readback; incomplete restores remain pending. Never starts charging.
